theme.strategy: Dark mode by default with Light mode toggle. Deep, cinematic, luxury aesthetic.

rules.h1: font-serif text-5xl md:text-6xl+ font-light tracking-tight text-white dark:text-white leading-none
rules.h2: font-serif text-3xl md:text-4xl font-light tracking-tight text-white dark:text-white leading-tight
rules.h3: font-serif text-2xl font-light tracking-tight text-white dark:text-white
rules.body: font-sans text-base font-normal tracking-normal text-gray-300 dark:text-gray-300 leading-relaxed

visual_enhancers.spotlight_hover: Use Framer Motion to track mouse position and apply a radial-gradient mask (rgba(201,169,110,0.15)) on hover over Bento grid items.
visual_enhancers.film_grain: Global SVG noise overlay with 4% opacity (pointer-events-none, fixed top-0 left-0 w-full h-full z-50).
visual_enhancers.vignette: Subtle radial gradient from transparent in the center to rgba(10,20,40,0.4) at the edges, fixed overlay.
visual_enhancers.gold_glow: For primary buttons and 3D edges: box-shadow or drop-shadow using #C9A96E with varying blur radii.
visual_enhancers.live_dots: Small SVG circles with Framer Motion pulse animation (scale 1 to 1.2, opacity 1 to 0) indicating 'LIVE' availability.

layouts_and_grids.spacing_scale: Generous spacing. Use p-8, p-12, p-24, py-32 for sections. Never cramp content.
layouts_and_grids.bento_grid: Asymmetric layouts. Base grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-6 or gap-8. Mix col-span-4, col-span-8, row-span-2 to create tension. No perfectly symmetric squares.
layouts_and_grids.alignment: Left-align text by default. Use asymmetry. Do not center-everything.
layouts_and_grids.section_counter: Fixed or sticky vertical layout element displaying '01 / 08', '02 / 08' in font-serif text-[#C9A96E] font-light.

motion.scrolling: MANDATORY: Lenis Smooth Scroll for premium momentum feel.
motion.hero_ken_burns: Slow scale (1.0 to 1.1) over 20 seconds on the hero image background.
motion.reveal_animations: Framer Motion: initial={ opacity: 0, y: 30, filter: 'blur(10px)' } whileInView={ opacity: 1, y: 0, filter: 'blur(0px)' } transition={ duration: 0.8, ease: 'easeOut' }
motion.parallax: Use Framer Motion useScroll and useTransform for slight Y-axis displacement on images vs background.
motion.camera_3d: Damped camera movements in R3F. OrbitControls with enableDamping=true, dampingFactor=0.05. Add Bloom from @react-three/postprocessing for the Gold-Kanten-Glow.

media.missing_images_fallback: NO STOCK PHOTOS. If an image is missing, implement a generative CSS background: linear-gradient(135deg, #0A1428, #13233F) with repeating-linear-gradient(45deg, transparent, transparent 10px, rgba(201,169,110,0.05) 10px, rgba(201,169,110,0.05) 11px).

section_by_section_design.name: 1. Hero Section
section_by_section_design.details: Fullscreen Ken-Burns image (hero_aerial). SVG Gold-Parcel animated overlay simulating property boundaries. Label-Pins via Framer Motion. Heavy emphasis on Cinematic Blue Hour feel. Bottom gradient to blend into next section.

section_by_section_design.name: 2. Leistungen Bento-Grid
section_by_section_design.details: 6 asymmetric tiles (Bewerten, Bewirtschaften, Beraten, Erbteilungen, Relocation, Immobilienbeteiligungen). Glassmorphism cards with Gold-Spotlight hover effect. Icons should be fine gold lines (Lucide react with strokeWidth={1}).

section_by_section_design.name: 3. Objekte (R3F Digital Twin)
section_by_section_design.details: Left side: R3F Canvas showing an abstract/stylized digital twin of Rorschach (use simple box geometries if no model, edge-lit with Gold Glow via Postprocessing Bloom). Damped fog (#0A1428). Right side: Scrollable glass listing cards (Landhaus Arezen, Dachwohnung Trischlistrasse) featuring LIVE availability dots (pulsing #C9A96E).

section_by_section_design.name: 4. AI-Schnellbewertung
section_by_section_design.details: 3-step interactive Wizard. Uses Shadcn customized inputs. Dark glass container. Result screen features an animated counter (0 to value) and a 'gold bandwidth bar' showing valuation range.

section_by_section_design.name: 5. Relocation & Erbschaften
section_by_section_design.details: Split cards section (col-span-12 md:col-span-6 each). High editorial feel. Lots of negative space. Generative gold/navy line art background if no image.

section_by_section_design.name: 6. Immobilienbeteiligungen
section_by_section_design.details: Deep dark section (#0A1428). Animated stats (e.g., 'CHF 250M+ Managed') with large Serif typography. Use useInView to trigger stat counter animations.

section_by_section_design.name: 7. Trust & Timeline
section_by_section_design.details: SIV & Casafair text badges (premium typography layout). 3 Core Values. A vertical timeline with gold glowing nodes and 1px #C9A96E/20 connecting line.

section_by_section_design.name: 8. Kontakt & Floating AI Chat
section_by_section_design.details: High-end form using customized Shadcn (transparent backgrounds, 1px gold bottom borders). Floating AI Chat button: Glass panel with a Gold-Orb button (CSS animated radial gradient). Fixed bottom right.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure #E6D3A8 text against #0A1428 passes APCA standards.
accessibility.testing: MANDATORY: Add `data-testid` to all interactive elements (e.g., data-testid='ai-valuation-step-1-btn').
accessibility.motion: Use prefers-reduced-motion media queries to disable Ken-Burns and Parallax for sensitive users.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use `.js` and `.jsx` extensions. Do NOT use `.tsx` as it is not supported in the current environment.
Component logic: Use Shadcn components for complex interactions but heavily override their Tailwind classes to match the luxury proptech glassmorphism theme.
Do not center text globally. Maintain optical alignment and Swiss-style tension.
Headers MUST NOT have a purely transparent background if content scrolls under them. Use backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#0A1428]/60 with a 1px bottom border of #C9A96E/20.
Implement the dark/light theme toggle, but default to dark mode. Ensure light mode uses the Off-White/Champagne-Gold palette gracefully without losing the premium feel.
R3F setup: Use @react-three/fiber and @react-three/drei. For the Gold-Kanten-Glow, use @react-three/postprocessing (EffectComposer, Bloom).
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and glassmorphism (backdrop-blur 12-24px).
DO NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Add transitions for specific interactive properties.
DO NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }).
Use modern button styles (pill-shaped or sharp) with interaction animations. The primary button should have a gold glow on hover.
NEVER use AI assistant emojis 🤖🧠💭. Use sleek SVG icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations: hover states, transitions, parallax, entrance animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
